propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and siblings into binding_lifecycle, which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but the blast radius narrowed and would not catch a regression that made moved operations stamp updated_at unconditionally.
The integration-tier oracle's reach must be restored by patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle modules to detect if any binding operation unconditionally stamps a timestamp.

The clear_absent no-stamp contract is already pinned at unit tier by test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, so the integration-tier coverage loss is contained.
